title: Learn OpenStack
subtitle: Resources from the Community & Foundation
intro: Looking for resources to learn more about using or developing OpenStack, finding out what's happening in the community, or watching experts talk OpenStack? This is your place.

cards.title: Training
cards.description: Find online and location specific trainings for all levels of expertise from the OpenStack Marketplace.

cards.title: Get Certified
cards.description: Register for the COA exam, the first professional certification offered by the Open Infrastructure Foundation.

cards.title: Superuser Magazine
cards.description: With topics ranging from how-tos, case studies, organizational culture and more, this publication will give you the tools needed to become a Superuser.

cards.title: Ask OpenStack
cards.description: Dig deep into the the world of OpenStack through the eyes of those who operate and develop OpenStack. Ask, find and answer OpenStack specific questions here.

cards.title: Summit Videos
cards.description: Did you know almost every session at an OpenStack Summit is recorded and shared for the world to see? They are and you can find them here!

cards.title: Analyst Reports
cards.description: Find the latest research and insights from leading technology analysts on the power of OpenStack’s cloud services.

cards.title: Blog
cards.description: The OpenStack blog is an ever-changing wealth of information, highlighting everything from technical committee updates to events and weekly community newsletters.

cards.title: News
cards.description: Read about the latest happenings in the OpenStack ecosystem. The news section features news from around the community and the Open Infrastructure Foundation.
